person: a bipedal figure with a head, torso, two arms, and two legs, often wearing clothing, with visible facial features and skin
bicycle: a two-wheeled human-powered vehicle with a metal frame, handlebars, pedals, a chain, spoked wheels, and a narrow seat
car: a four-wheeled enclosed motor vehicle with a windshield, headlights, side mirrors, doors, windows, and a license plate
motorcycle: a two-wheeled motorized vehicle with an exposed engine, fuel tank, handlebars, exhaust pipes, and a narrow seat
airplane: a large winged aircraft with a cylindrical fuselage, jet engines or propellers, a tail fin, landing gear, and rows of windows
bus: a large elongated motor vehicle with many windows in rows, a flat front, a destination sign, and doors for passenger entry
train: a long rail vehicle with multiple connected carriages, wheels on tracks, windows in rows, and a locomotive at the front
truck: a large motor vehicle with a cab in front and a separate cargo bed or trailer behind, larger than a car with heavy-duty wheels
boat: a watercraft with a hull that floats, a deck, a bow and stern, and may have sails, a motor, a cabin, or a mast
traffic light: a vertical signal device mounted on a pole with three circular lights arranged top to bottom in red, yellow, and green
fire hydrant: a short stout metal post, typically red or yellow, with outlet nozzles and a bonnet on top, found near curbs
stop sign: a red octagonal metal sign with white border and the word STOP in white capital letters, mounted on a pole
parking meter: a small upright metal device on a post with a coin slot, display window, and timer mechanism, found along sidewalks
bench: a long outdoor seat with a flat horizontal surface, a backrest, supporting legs, often made of wood slats on a metal frame
bird: a small feathered animal with a beak, two wings, two clawed feet, a tail, and a streamlined body capable of flight
cat: a small furry domesticated animal with pointed ears, whiskers, slit-shaped pupils, a long flexible tail, and retractable claws
dog: a domesticated four-legged animal with fur, a snout, floppy or pointed ears, a wagging tail, paws, and a collar often visible
horse: a large four-legged animal with hooves, a long mane and tail, an elongated head, muscular body, sometimes wearing a saddle
sheep: a stocky woolly animal with a thick white fleece, a small head, short ears, hooves, and a compact barrel-shaped body
cow: a large domesticated bovine with a broad body, an udder, hooves, a tail with a tuft, and often black-and-white spotted markings
elephant: a very large gray animal with thick wrinkled skin, a long prehensile trunk, large floppy ears, tusks, and pillar-like legs
bear: a large heavy-bodied animal with thick fur, a broad head, small rounded ears, large paws with claws, and a short tail
zebra: a horse-like African animal with distinctive black and white vertical stripes covering its entire body, mane, and legs
giraffe: an extremely tall African animal with a very long neck, long legs, a spotted brown-on-tan coat pattern, and small horn-like ossicones
backpack: a fabric bag with two shoulder straps, a main zippered compartment, side pockets, worn on the back for carrying items
umbrella: a collapsible canopy on a central shaft with radiating ribs, a curved or straight handle, used for rain or sun protection
handbag: a small to medium bag with a handle or shoulder strap, a closure mechanism, made of leather or fabric, carried by hand
tie: a long narrow strip of fabric worn around the neck under a shirt collar, tapering to a point, with a knot at the top
suitcase: a rectangular rigid or soft-sided travel case with a telescoping handle, wheels on the bottom, and a zippered closure
frisbee: a flat circular plastic disc with a raised rim, lightweight and aerodynamic, designed for throwing and catching
skis: a pair of long narrow flat planks with curved tips, bindings for boots, and metal edges, used for gliding on snow
snowboard: a single wide flat board with boot bindings on top, metal edges, a graphic design underneath, used for riding on snow
sports ball: a spherical object with a textured or paneled surface, used in various games, with visible seams or valve for inflation
kite: a lightweight frame covered with fabric or paper, flown in the wind on a long string, often colorful with a diamond or delta shape
baseball bat: a long cylindrical wooden or metal club with a narrow handle tapering to a wider barrel end, with a knob at the grip
baseball glove: a padded leather mitt with finger stalls, webbing between thumb and fingers, creating a pocket for catching balls
skateboard: a flat wooden deck on four small polyurethane wheels attached by two metal trucks, with grip tape on the riding surface
surfboard: a long streamlined board with a pointed or rounded nose, fins on the underside, made of foam and fiberglass, for riding waves
tennis racket: a handled frame with an oval head strung with a tight mesh of strings, a grip-taped handle, used for hitting a ball
bottle: a cylindrical container with a narrow neck, a cap or lid, made of glass or plastic, used for holding liquids, with a label
wine glass: a transparent glass drinking vessel with a wide bowl on a thin stem resting on a flat circular base
cup: a small cylindrical drinking vessel with a handle on one side, made of ceramic or paper, used for hot or cold beverages
fork: a metal eating utensil with a handle and three or four pointed tines at one end, used for piercing and lifting food
knife: a metal eating or cutting utensil with a handle and a flat blade with a sharp or serrated edge
spoon: a metal eating utensil with a handle and a shallow oval bowl at one end, used for scooping and stirring
bowl: a round concave dish with a wide opening and curved walls, made of ceramic or glass, used for holding food or liquid
banana: a curved elongated yellow tropical fruit with a thick peel, growing in clusters, with soft white flesh inside
apple: a round fruit with smooth red, green, or yellow skin, a small stem on top, and firm white flesh with a central seed core
sandwich: two slices of bread with layered fillings of meat, cheese, vegetables, and condiments visible between them
orange: a round citrus fruit with a dimpled orange-colored rind, a slight stem indentation at top, and juicy segmented interior
broccoli: a green vegetable with a thick pale stem topped by a dense cluster of small dark green florets in a tree-like shape
carrot: an elongated tapered orange root vegetable with a smooth skin, a pointed tip, and feathery green leaves at the top
hot dog: a cooked sausage placed lengthwise in a sliced soft bread bun, often topped with mustard, ketchup, or relish
pizza: a flat circular baked dough base topped with tomato sauce, melted cheese, and various toppings, with a raised crust edge
donut: a round fried pastry with a hole in the center, often coated with glazed icing, sugar, or topped with sprinkles
cake: a layered baked dessert with frosting between and on top of soft sponge layers, often decorated with icing and candles
chair: a piece of furniture with a flat seat, a vertical backrest, and four legs, made of wood, metal, or plastic, for one person to sit
couch: a large upholstered piece of furniture with a wide seat, cushions, armrests, and a backrest, seating multiple people
potted plant: a living plant growing in a container pot filled with soil, with green leaves, stems, and sometimes flowers visible
bed: a large piece of furniture with a flat mattress on a frame, pillows at one end, covered with sheets and a blanket or comforter
dining table: a flat-topped piece of furniture with legs, at standard eating height, often surrounded by chairs, used for meals
toilet: a white porcelain bathroom fixture with a bowl, hinged seat and lid, a water tank behind, and a flush handle or button
tv: a flat rectangular electronic screen with a thin profile, a narrow bezel, mounted on a stand or wall, displaying images and video
laptop: a portable folding computer with a flat screen on top connected by a hinge to a keyboard and trackpad on the bottom half
mouse: a small handheld computer input device with a curved top, left and right click buttons, a scroll wheel, and a flat gliding base
remote: a small rectangular handheld device with an array of buttons, used to wirelessly control a television or other electronics
keyboard: a flat rectangular input device with rows of labeled keys for letters, numbers, symbols, a spacebar, and modifier keys
cell phone: a thin rectangular handheld device with a large glass touchscreen, a camera on back, slim profile with rounded corners
microwave: a box-shaped kitchen appliance with a front door containing a window, a control panel with buttons, and a turntable inside
oven: a large insulated kitchen appliance with a front door with a glass window, interior racks, temperature knobs or controls
toaster: a small kitchen appliance with slots on top for bread, a push-down lever, browning dial, and a chrome or colored housing
sink: a fixed basin with a faucet above it and a drain below, mounted in a countertop, made of stainless steel or porcelain
refrigerator: a tall rectangular kitchen appliance with a door, handle, and interior shelves and drawers for cold food storage
book: a bound set of printed pages with a front and back cover, a spine along one edge, containing text and sometimes illustrations
clock: a timekeeping device with a circular face displaying numbers, hour and minute hands radiating from a center point
vase: a decorative container with a narrow neck and wider body, an opening at top for holding flowers, made of ceramic or glass
scissors: a cutting tool with two metal blades joined at a pivot, each with a finger ring handle, forming an X shape when open
teddy bear: a soft stuffed toy in the shape of a bear with plush fur, button eyes, a stitched nose and mouth, and jointed limbs
hair drier: a handheld electrical appliance with a pistol-grip handle, a cylindrical barrel with a nozzle, and a power cord, blowing hot air
toothbrush: a small personal hygiene tool with a narrow handle and a compact head covered with rows of short nylon bristles at one end
